title: Router escalation
question: Should this request be answered by a local open-weights model (about 30B parameters, running on this machine) or escalated to a frontier cloud model?

choices.local: a capable ~30B local model will do this well: routine code, small edits, formatting, summarising or translating supplied text, extraction, classification, common knowledge
choices.cloud: needs frontier capability: hard multi-step reasoning, subtle debugging across a large system, novel design trade-offs, very long inputs, expert legal/medical/financial nuance, or facts newer than an open model knows

rubric: Labelled by difficulty alone, the axis config/ai-router.yaml does not route on today. Privacy is deliberately NOT a label signal: a sensitive request that is easy is still 'local' here; the router would keep it local anyway. 'local' means a Qwen3-Coder-30B / Gemma-4-31B class model would produce an answer a careful reviewer accepts on the first try more often than not.
labeller: Hand-written and hand-labelled by the Claude Opus 5.5 session running brief 05 (not a model under test). Real router prompts were not read: the request logs hold other people's text.
